name: United Kingdom
officialName: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

population.kidComparison: About 68 million people live across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

geography.climate: Mild, rainy maritime climate—weather can change from sunshine to drizzle in a single afternoon.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: The Union Jack: red and white crosses overlapping on a dark blue background.

anthem.title: God Save the King
anthem.summary: One of the oldest national anthems in the world, dating back to the 1740s.

exploration.didYouKnow: London's Underground, opened in 1863, is the oldest underground passenger railway in the world.
